title: Prescribed-qbot perturbation envelope
question: What is the strongest prospectively tested prescribed-qbot perturbation for which the analytical reference remains convergent and the adaptive representation preserves all frozen fidelity and nonlinear-path gates across all 12 material-regime cases?

frozen.candidate_representation: same F-AHL16 selected representation as F-AHL21

selection_rule: Select the smallest factor, hence the largest prospectively tested flux imbalance, for which the analytical reference converges and all 12 candidate cases pass. Do not reinterpret F-AHL21 0.90 as a passing level.
